platforms.name: Google Ads (Search)
platforms.best_for: Capturing existing demand from people actively searching for legal tech solutions
platforms.notes: Requires keyword research. HubSpot can track conversions from Google Ads natively.

platforms.name: Google Ads (Display / GDN)
platforms.best_for: Broad awareness and retargeting website visitors across the web
platforms.notes: Great for retargeting. Low CPCs but also lower intent. Requires image assets.

platforms.name: LinkedIn Ads
platforms.best_for: Precise B2B targeting by job title, company, industry, seniority — ideal for legal professionals
platforms.notes: Most expensive per click but highest quality B2B targeting. Lead Gen Forms can bypass the need for a landing page. LinkedIn Insight Tag integrates with HubSpot.

platforms.name: Meta Ads (Facebook / Instagram)
platforms.best_for: Broad awareness, retargeting, and lookalike audiences. Less precise B2B targeting than LinkedIn but much cheaper.
platforms.notes: B2B targeting is weaker than LinkedIn — relies more on interest/behavior signals. Best used for retargeting or alongside LinkedIn.

platforms.name: YouTube Ads (via Google Ads)
platforms.best_for: Video-based brand awareness and thought leadership — requires video assets
platforms.notes: Requires video production capability. B2B targeting is via Google Audiences (not as precise as LinkedIn). Best for thought leadership and brand building.

platforms.name: Industry Publications & Sponsorships
platforms.best_for: Reaching legal professionals in trusted, high-credibility industry contexts
platforms.notes: Pricing is typically flat-rate (not CPC/CPM bidding). Negotiate directly with publications. Often requires longer lead times (4-8 weeks).

platforms.name: Programmatic Display (via DSP)
platforms.setup_url: Requires DSP platform (e.g., StackAdapt, The Trade Desk)
platforms.best_for: Advanced targeting at scale — usually better for larger budgets or with agency/platform support
platforms.notes: Not recommended for teams just starting with digital advertising. Consider this once you've mastered Google Ads and LinkedIn.
